# kirillovec

> kirillovec is a Russian-language creative AI studio for musicians, independent artists and music releases.

## Main pages
- https://kirillovec.ru/ — project homepage
- https://kirillovec.ru/studio/ — AI Studio for image generation, image editing and prompt preparation
- https://kirillovec.ru/artist/ — artist profile and music release information
- https://kirillovec.ru/творчество/ — creative portfolio sections
- https://kirillovec.ru/guides/ — practical guides for music visuals
- https://kirillovec.ru/guides/rap-cover-prompt/ — guide to writing prompts for rap single and album covers

## What the studio is for
- Developing visual concepts for rap, hip-hop and independent music releases.
- Preparing prompts for cover art, artist portraits and cinematic scenes.
- Generating or editing images when the image model API is available.
- Preparing video prompts and handing them off to external video platforms.

## Important capability notes
- Image generation depends on the availability and configuration of the site's Cloudflare Workers AI API.
- Video generation is currently prepared through prompts and external services; the site does not claim to render video internally.
- Availability, free credits and usage limits of external platforms are controlled by those platforms.
- Users should only upload images they have permission to use.

## Language and audience
- Primary language: Russian.
- Audience: musicians, rappers, independent artists and creators who need visual assets for music releases.

## Contact and ownership
- Project name: kirillovec.
- Website: https://kirillovec.ru/
